author: Clijmart
body:
I asked ingame what game I should make a map for, I got told to do DTC or Tnt DTM, so I combined them...
The map has 1 thin core, and 1 emerald monument.
It has a lot of tnt chests and a few diamond blocks with tnt underneath.

Authors:
Clijmart and mepii (Thanks imryaan for the suggestions <3)
